title: Launch post (several issues)
text: Join 2 million happy users of LumoraPay! We are India's fastest payment app and every transfer arrives instantly. Tap the green button above to sign up now or miss your chance.

title: Fee email (claims and guarantees)
text: Good news: all transfers are always free and you are guaranteed to save money every month with Lumora Pay. Lumora Pay supports transfers in 12 currencies, so you can pay anyone, anywhere.

title: App update note (tone and next steps)
text: We would like to take this opportunity to inform you that our new infrastructure migration is now live. Check your spend dashboard (SID) for monthly spend. You're all set.

title: Clean example (should pass)
text: Spend Insights groups eligible transactions by spending category, so you can see where your money goes. Turn on transaction notifications in the Lumora app settings to stay updated.
